contract.note: The plain readings are ordinary: method comparisons for brain and child, dependable comprehension for language, dependable behaviour for alignment and trust. Limiting the check to the May 2022 Gato is fair. Requiring all five parts and not treating untested as absent is balanced.

evidence.note: The original Gato report, May 12, 2022. It describes offline supervised training and says harm mitigation needs more research before deployment. Both fit some of the assertions, but they are DeepMind's own disclosures. It reports rudimentary language abilities but no comprehension or alignment tests. It settles no assertion under the contract and contradicts none.

reviews.rationale: The report is consistent with the training-method and deployment-caution points. It has no evaluations that establish or refute dependable language comprehension, value alignment, or mission-critical reliability. The contract needs all five assertions substantiated and no contradiction is shown, so the packet does not settle the claim.
